description: Type into an input, textarea or editable element by ref, replacing its text. A text field is clicked first (or focused, when the click cannot reach it), so a browser_click on it just before is usually not needed; a native date, time, month, week, color or range input gets its value set directly, with no click. Returns evidence.

ref.description: From the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12" or "f1e3"

snapshot.description: Default true; false: evidence and notes only, as in browser_click.

name: browser_type
title: Type
